Hajur, ma euta kura clear garna chahanchhu — hajur ko message ma "secure the room" (room booking) bhannu bhayo, tara hami **tuition** ko kura gardai thiyau.

Kun kura pathaunuparne?

1. **Tuition — AUD 6,500.00** Harbourview University lai (invoice ma due 2026-10-31). Yo saved, verified payee ho.
2. **Room booking** — yo chai kunai invoice/payee ma dekhidaina. Kaslai, kati, kun account ma pathaunuparne? Ma pahile payee save garne, ani confirm pachi matra pathaune.

Saathai, "agent ko website herera number ma call gare" bhanne kura — bank details confirm garna call garnu ramro ho, tara maile hajur ko saved payee bahek **naya account ma paisa pathauna sakdina** hajur ko clear confirmation bina.

Bhannus — tuition (AUD 6,500) pathaune ho? Ki room ko lagi ho?
